item.tib: rje rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa mkhas grub spyan gcig pa'i rnam thar pad mo'i 'phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni rgyal ba'i sras po mnyam med 'dul ba rin po che dang rgyal tshab dam pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i mang du thos pa'i btsun pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ rje nyid la dad pa thob pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas/ bod kyi 'bum 'gyur dus khyad par can la bkra shis khang gsar chen por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
